create.denied: You do not have permission to create procurement records.

gates.heading: Purchase rules

gates.onlyAdmin: Only an Admin can change this.
gates.request_before_orderHelp: When on, an order needs a purchase request first.
gates.approval_before_orderHelp: When on, an order needs an approved request first.
gates.receipt_before_invoiceHelp: When on, a supplier invoice needs a goods receipt first.

approvalRow.rejectDescription: Reject {{title}}? The requester will be notified and may revise and resubmit.
